parity.notes: WS5 probe pair (loop plan D5.1, class W5-B). Counted on the reference solutions: 1 module/static class + 6 functions; complexity 1 per function + 1 per branch: QuoteWithSurcharge 2, QuoteWithFloor 2, others 1 = 10 per arm. Starting fixtures are the identical 4-function module in both arms, both carrying the injected boundary defect. Probe pairs are never gate-eligible: they exist to measure M-W1/PP-W1 (gates doc Annex A-1.2), not the language gates.
